data_access.fit_targets: F normal groups and same-seed frozen F scores
data_access.calibration_evaluation: C/E only after all six trajectories/checkpoints frozen

grouping.split: cycle feature priority by depth, legal boundary nearest half; equal-distance smaller boundary
grouping.manifest: F-only group contract in consolidated design
grouping.sparse: unsplittable parent remains leaf; no pooled fallback
grouping.unknown_profile: F/V non-A/B reject contract; D has no forced group and is evaluated by original cells

targets.quantile: left inverse empirical CDF; ascending x[max(1,ceil(N*u))]
targets.rank: average ascending rank for ties, one-based
targets.consistency: merge identical frozen FP32 model-input normal equivalence classes using minimum provisional target
targets.final: minimum provisional target among identical network inputs; never exceeds own original_score
targets.interpretation: fixed discrete quantile midpoint target plus input-consistency adjustment, not online or exact continuous optimal transport
targets.tie_note: provisional within-group targets preserve score order; final equivalence-class min can change local order

objective.A_batch: sum_i_in_normal_batch N_source_normal/(64*G*n_group_i) * ((s_theta(x_i)-target_i)/delta)^2; no extra batch division
objective.normal_anchor: all normal target errors are two-sided squared errors, including rows with unchanged target
objective.positive_anchor: one-sided ensemble-score non-decrease soft penalty; hard protection enforced by evaluation contract
objective.gradient_mode: one train-mode BCE forward plus one eval-mode auxiliary forward on same batch, eval-mode keeps autograd; one joint backward/clip/step

training.control: all normal targets original same-seed F score; all else identical, including protection
training.precision: FP32 network, existing FP64 stable_scores scalar path, no AMP
training.sampler: four independently shuffled cyclic queues A0/A1/B0/B1, 64 each
training.target_cache: future registered preflight: same deterministic CPU scoring path regenerates frozen F/V reference from original same-seed checkpoint; archived GPU F scores remain historical evidence

selection.contract: consolidated evaluation contract defines exact hard gates and rank-tail scalar
selection.mechanism: V normal rank-tail group enrichment at pooled top 10%,5%,1%, fractional boundary ties

ce_targets.FP_budget: floor(normal_n/100) per cell; each seed separately

selection.tie_break: minimum H among safe checkpoints; earliest step for exact H ties; pAUC is protection gate only

principle.title: Auditing and Enforcing Conditional Fairness via Optimal Transport

implementation.title: Towards Marginal Fairness Sliced Wasserstein Barycenter
used: groupwise distribution term with base loss

exit: constant target or no possible rank-tail mechanism change
on fails to beat matched off
any seed/cell fails fixed FP budget
